content.instructions: The helping verb is in second position and the participle goes to the very end. If you start with a time word, the subject moves behind the helping verb. In a question the helping verb comes first.
text:
The Perfekt bracket
TypeListenExample
statementIch habe am Samstag Freunde besucht.
time firstAm Samstag habe ich Freunde besucht.
yes/no questionHaben Sie Pizza gegessen?
question wordWas haben Sie am Wochenende gemacht?
